content: Baseline simulated candidates 1 and 2. Cand 1 had excellent gain (642) and noise (19.7mV) but low UGBW (23.5MHz), PM (37 deg), and SR (21.2V/us). Cand 2 confirmed short ln1=45nm drops gain to 98V/V, while smaller Cc without sufficient gm6 hit the gm6/CL pole limit. Plan: return to ln1=90nm for gain > 200; raise I_2 (mn5) and mp3 to push gm6/CL out, boosting UGBW and SR while improving PM. Cc around 1.0-1.2pF and Rc around 1.2-1.5k.

Best design id: 1. Binding spec: ugbw (-0.619), followed by phm (-0.236) and slewRate (-0.173). Chosen lever: boost stage-2 current and gm6 by setting mn5=6, mp3=12 (maintains balance condition S_mp3/S_mp1 = 6 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4) and lowering Cc from 2.0pF to 1.2pF. Trade-off: current increases to ~270uA, but unlocks SR >= 30V/us and pushes p2 out to enable UGBW and PM recovery.

Candidate 5 reached ugbw=89.33MHz (predicted >80M, confirmed), slewRate=43.49V/us (confirmed), gain=487.8. But phm dropped to 32.67 deg because Cc=0.6pF is too small for p2 separation and Rc=1200 placed zero sub-optimally. Lesson: UGBW is now nearly satisfied; fixing PM requires slightly larger Cc (0.8-1.0pF) and tuning Rc to place the lead zero right at UGBW.

Best design id: 5. Binding specs: phm (-0.295) and ugbw (-0.0563). Chosen lever: sweep nulling resistor Rc between 1600 and 3600 ohms to place the zero fz = 1/(2*pi*Cc*(Rc - 1/gm6)) near 100MHz, generating up to 30-40 deg phase lead to achieve feasibility (PM >= 60 deg, UGBW >= 100MHz).

Rc sweep completed. Best in sweep is candidate 11 with res=3800, achieving feasibility! Reward=0.4724 (FoM > 0.3). Specs: phm=61.9 deg, ugbw=116.1MHz, slewRate=42.91V/us, area=5.18e-10, current=484.9uA. Phase 1 Feasibility complete in 11 simulator calls (3 decisions). Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 2 optimization.

Candidate 11 is feasible (FoM=0.4724). Current penalty z_current=0.416 is the main drag on FoM, while slewRate (42.9 vs 30) and ugbw (116 vs 100) have margin. Lever: increase wn3 1.0u -> 1.25u to reduce I_tail and I_2 by ~20% without perturbing balance condition; adjust res 3800 -> 4200 to protect PM >= 60 deg. Trade excess SR/UGBW margin for lower current to boost FoM.

Cand 13 achieved feasibility with improved FoM=0.5223 (mn1=20, res=4500, wn3=1.25u, current=397uA). Cand 14 tested res=4200 to reduce area, but UGBW dropped to 98.73MHz. Lesson: res=4500 is needed to keep UGBW >= 100MHz with current=397uA. Best design remains candidate 13. Handing back to diagnoser.

Handover to RL. Best design candidate 13 is feasible (FoM=0.5223), with tight margins on UGBW (102.6MHz vs 100MHz) and PM (61.58 deg vs 60 deg). Hand sizing has optimized topology balance and discrete sizing. Stalling at discrete boundary. Handing over to rl-strategist to perform TD3 local refinement anchored on candidate 13.

RL refinement completed. Used 700 simulations (100 warmup + 600 train). Best feasible id improved from cand 13 (FoM=0.5223) to cand 253 (FoM=0.5585). 32 feasible designs found. Key parameter changes from expert: mn5 decreased from 12 to 7 (cutting stage-2 current to 281uA), ln1/lp1/ln4 increased to 135nm (gain doubled to 1097 V/V), res increased to 7100 ohms, cap to 0.7pF (PM=63.1 deg, UGBW=103.3MHz). Stopping after 2 non-improving batches. Handing over to phase 4 polish.

Phase 4 Polish. Best design is cand 253 (FoM=0.5585). Area (8.03e-10) is heavily dominated by res=7100. Hard constraints are satisfied with ugbw=103.3MHz and phm=63.1 deg. Lever: sweep res from 5900 to 7500 ohms on cand 253 to find the smallest resistance (lowest area) that maintains feasibility, directly improving FoM.

Phase 4 Polish complete. Res sweep followed by targeted res=6900 simulation produced candidate 719, improving FoM to 0.5658. Specs: ugbw=101.0MHz, phm=63.45 deg, slewRate=49.13V/us, current=281.2uA, area=7.88e-10. All constraints feasible. Handing over to diagnoser/orchestrator.

RL Round 2 complete. Total RL simulator calls used: 200 (50 warmup + 150 train). Best design improved to candidate 751 with FoM=0.6176 (area=5.37e-10, current=340uA, gain=340.8, phm=61.12 deg, slewRate=60.11V/us, ugbw=105.0MHz). 55 feasible designs now exist across the Pareto front. Key parameters of 751: mp1=4, mn1=14, mp3=16, mn5=12 with wn5=500nm, cap=0.6pF, res=4100 ohms. Ready for final phase 4 polish.

Phase 4 Polish on RL best (candidate 751, FoM=0.6176). Binding margin is PM (61.12 deg vs 60 deg) and UGBW (105MHz vs 100MHz). Lever: 4-point sweep of nulling resistor Rc around 4100 ohms ([3800, 4000, 4200, 4400]) to check if lower Rc can trim area or higher Rc strengthens PM margin.

Phase 4 Polish complete. Rc sweep found candidate 921 with res=4000, establishing new highest FoM=0.6221. Specs: phm=60.56 deg, ugbw=103.6MHz, slewRate=60.10V/us, area=5.29e-10, current=340uA. Zero constraint violations. All budgets satisfied. Handing over to Reviewer.

Review complete. Final design is candidate 921 with FoM=0.6221 (feasible, 0 violated constraints). Lineage, trade-offs, and design story documented in harness_runs/harness_20261106_222948/explanation.md. Total simulator calls used: 923, elapsed time: 1002.4s.
